GeoLite2-City-Test.mmdb and GeoLite2-ASN-Test.mmdb are test databases from
MaxMind's MaxMind-DB repository, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/6a690a705bc6962c0025a32e94a8f0dc8f86418c/test-data

They hold synthetic records for a handful of networks, written to exercise
MaxMind DB readers. They are not GeoLite2 releases and carry none of the
GeoLite2 licence terms.
